description: Assembles a bilingual (French/English) Quebec invoice document with GST/QST computed exactly per Revenu Quebec's current formula -- you supply both languages' line-item text, this does not translate. Not legal or tax advice.

line_items.description: Each item needs description_en, description_fr (both required -- this assembles, it does not translate), and amount.

name: post_quebec_invoice_generate
